newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-SECOND DOPE TEST CONFIRMS LAMA POSITIVE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SECOND DOPE TEST CONFIRMS LAMA POSITIVE.

text.p: Paris St Germain's French international goalkeeper Bernard Lama was confirmed on Friday as having tested positive for cannabis and faces a two-month suspension.

The result of the second urine sample analysed earlier this week confirmed February's positive test and Lama will be asked to appear before the French Football Federation's (FFF) doping commission within the next 10 days, the FFF's director of communications Jean-Yves Le Huede said.
